title: ONE-STEP tagging: a versatile method for rapid site-specific integration by simultaneous reagent delivery

equation_quality.supported_scope: See exact linked equations and parameter states; successful replay is not mechanism identification.

independent_units.independent_unit_description: Named experimental replicate block A/B/C; three doses within each

calibration_burden: One source BOB negative control defines each channel threshold at its 99.5th percentile, identically for all wells and models. Event gating uses finite scatter/fluorescence and positive FSC-A/SSC-A only; source FlowJo manual gates were not supplied and are not reproduced.

baseline_strength.scope: Matched task/input access; historical controls are not claimed to exhaust state of the art.
